_comment: Per-clip ingest config for the precompute pipeline (api/scripts/precompute.py). Carries the HUMAN knowledge the vision models cannot supply: where the source clip lives, which window/fps to sample, the known goal moment, the evidence frames the demo renders, and the hand-verified jersey pin that keeps the hero #10 correct. The pipeline samples on the SAME stride the hero program uses (fps 8 over 3500-5000ms => stride 125ms => 13 keys incl. 4625), runs Azure detect per sampled ts, mints det_ids, then resolves the pin by nearest-box AFTER detect so det_ids are stable. `clip.source` is the clip->.mov resolution (kept IN the manifest so canned.py / canned.CLIPS stay untouched). Paths are relative to the repo root.

sampling._comment: MUST match the hero program's sample_frames args (start_ms/end_ms/fps) so the detect keys align with what op_sample_frames derives (stride = round(1000/fps) = 125; ts = range(start, end+1, 125)). detect_on='all' => detect on every sampled ts in the window (12-13 frames @ 8fps; cheap and robust). Alt 'evidence' would detect only on evidence + event frames (sparse).

ocr._comment: Sub-region cropped from each person box before OCR. Matches op_crop's 'jersey' math (x+0.22w, y+0.10h, 0.56w, 0.22h) so the cache crop band lines up with what the interpreter shows. scale upsamples the small number band for the VLM.

events._comment: The known goal moment. scorer_det is the SEMANTIC id the pin mints (see pins[].det_id); the pipeline rewrites this scorer_det from the pin-resolution result, it is NOT trusted as an independent literal. box is the ball/goal overlay shown by op_temporal_order.

pins._comment: Hand-verified jersey read for the hero #10 (Messi). Matched to the nearest detection box at frame_ts_ms AFTER detect runs; the matched det is RENAMED to det_id (p_messi) and gets this read_text written under that same id. nearest_box is the approximate person box at 4625ms used only for the nearest-match (the real cached box comes from Azure). Azure Read misreads the stylized WC numeral (22 -> 77) so this is pinned, not live.
pins.note: Hand-verified. Azure Read misreads the stylized WC numeral (22 -> 77); gpt-4o vision pending TPM quota. The 10 is human-legible and pinned for the hero query (disclosed in the demo).

evidence_frames._comment: ts<=4200 frame the EvidencePanel renders for the goal moment. filename is reproduced EXACTLY (frameSrc in EvidencePanel.tsx is NOT edited).
the scorer frame (#10 legible). filename reproduced exactly.
